item.title: Gone Home: Brian Lloyd
item.description: It is with sadness that we share the news that Brian Lloyd, a previous County Chair, passed away yesterday.We thank him for his service to Staffordshire Scouts and pass our condolences on to his family and friends.Rest in peace, Brian. item.title: Happy Christmas
item.description: Staffordshire Scouts would like to wish everyone a very Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! Please note: the County Office will close for the holidays at 4pm on Thursday 22nd December. It will reopen on Tuesday 3rd January 2023.
